name: Model or solver issue
about: Report a reproducible discrepancy or propose a change to settlement semantics
---
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0 -->

Which command and revision did you run?

Include a minimal synthetic obligation book, the funding and eligibility assumptions, and the observed result. What allocation or status did you expect, and why?

For a proposed rule change, describe an alternative and a test that distinguishes the two. For a suspected security vulnerability, use the private reporting route in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Circulattice/circulattice-core/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
